description: Department of The Local Government N.C.P - Appointed Chairman and Vice Chairman for the Anuradgapura Local Authorities 2025
reasoning: This gazette contains appointments of Chairmen and Vice Chairmen for Local Government Authorities (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes and appointments to elected local government positions, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) as it involves declarations of appointments to local authority positions following electoral procedures.
